[[Ramtha Brokenhoof]] is the leader of the [[Maguuma Jungle]]'s [[Centaur]]s and a driving force behind an anti-[[human]] alliance with the Centaurs of the [[Shiverpeak Mountains]]. Stopping his negotiations with the Shiverpeak centaur leader [[Horm Frostrider]] is the bonus objective in [[The Wilds]].
